ibs_n.name: Internal Bar Strength look back n bars
ibs_n.comment: ibs_n = (close - lowest(n)) / (highest(n) - lowest(n)) with n = IBS_LOOKBACK

is_fvg.name: Is Fair Value Gap
is_fvg.comment: is_fvg = True if (high_prev > low_curr) or (low_prev < high_curr) else False

ulti_osci.name: Ultimate Oscillator
ulti_osci.comment: Ultimate Oscillator = ta.ultimate_oscillator(high, low, close, length=n) with n = VOLATILITY_LOOKBACK

atr.name: Average True Range
atr.comment: atr = ta.atr(high, low, close, length=n) with n = VOLATILITY_LOOKBACK

adx.name: Average Directional Index
adx.comment: adx = ta.adx(high, low, close, length=n) with n = ADX_VOLATILITY_LOOKBACKLOOKBACK

streak.name: Up/Down Streak
streak.comment: up_streak = 0 if direction != direction_lag1 else direction + up_streak_lag1

donchian_width.name: Donchian Channel Width
donchian_width.comment: (rolling max High - rolling min Low) / channel midpoint with n = VOLATILITY_LOOKBACK

donchian_position.name: Donchian Channel Position
donchian_position.comment: (Close - rolling min Low) / (rolling max High - rolling min Low) with n = VOLATILITY_LOOKBACK

amihud_liquidity.name: Amihud Liquidity Proxy
amihud_liquidity.comment: Rolling quote-volume proxy per normalized intraday shortest path adapted from quant-ohlcv-feature

keltner_position.name: Keltner Channel Position
keltner_position.comment: (Close - EMA(Close,n) + 2 * ATR) / (4 * ATR) adapted from quant-ohlcv-feature

body_to_true_range.name: Body to True Range
body_to_true_range.comment: Absolute candlestick body divided by true range

fear_greed_yidai_v1.name: Fear Greed Yidai v1
fear_greed_yidai_v1.comment: Weighted momentum of bullish and bearish true-range amplitudes

damaov10.name: Damaov10
damaov10.comment: Coppock, Bollinger width, and ATR composite

adx_mtm.name: ADX MTM
adx_mtm.comment: Positive directional movement multiplied by rolling momentum

Cvr_v0.name: Calmar-Volume Ratio
Cvr_v0.comment: Cumulative return over rolling return volatility multiplied by relative quote volume

Cbr_v1.name: Coppock Bollinger Ratio v1
Cbr_v1.comment: Coppock-style momentum multiplied by Bollinger bandwidth and price-volume correlation

Fbnq_pct_v5.name: Fibonacci momentum volatility composite
Fbnq_pct_v5.comment: Fibonacci EMA momentum percent change multiplied by average Bollinger bandwidth

PriceVolumeResist.name: Price Volume Resistance
PriceVolumeResist.comment: Close-to-volume breakout difficulty ratio normalized by window length

adx_mtm.name: ADX MTM
adx_mtm.comment: Positive directional movement multiplied by rolling momentum

Mtam.name: Mtam
Mtam.comment: Momentum times taker buy ratio times ATR volatility composite

Msbt.name: Msbt
Msbt.comment: Momentum, std momentum, BBW, and taker buy composite

CoppAtrBull.name: CoppAtrBull
CoppAtrBull.comment: Coppock momentum times ATR times taker buy activity

adx_mtm_neg.name: ADX MTM Neg
adx_mtm_neg.comment: Negative directional movement multiplied by rolling momentum
